title: feat(spec,ui)!: a record opens one way per object — navigation.mode keeps drawer (the default), page, new_window and none; modal, split and popover are retired; the split pane becomes a reader preference
body:
Fixes #26677

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

Child 1 of the record-page-v2 epic #26676. The maintainer's ruling, verbatim from the card: 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」 This PR ships its declaration half and the console's read of it.

## What changes

### Spec (`@objectstack/spec`)

- `NavigationModeSchema` is `drawer | page | new_window | none`, built with `enumWithRetiredValues`: `modal`, `split` and `popover` are refused by name, each with its prescription (first sentence: "`navigation.mode: 'modal'` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18.3.0 (ADR-0087 D2) — …"). `NavigationConfigSchema.mode` defaults to `drawer` (it was `page`). The one def sits behind every carrier: a list view, an object's `listViews`, and the eight page list blocks (`list-view`, `object-grid`, `object-kanban`, `object-calendar`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`, `object-tree`, `object-timeline`).
- `InterfacePageConfigSchema.recordAction` is `drawer | page | none`; `modal` is refused with its prescription. `page.form.ts` drops the Modal option.
- The retirement kit, value-level route (`spec-property-retirement` §2, re-read after `dbf7e04adf`):
  - D2 conversion `navigation-mode-overlay-values-removed` (`retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, MAJOR_18 order 77): deletes a retired member from every carrier above and from `interfaceConfig.recordAction`, so a stored `sys_metadata` row (Studio's list-view inspector offered all seven modes and `PUT /meta/view` persisted them) converts on read and lands on the drawer. Fixture: 5 notices, disjoint.
  - D3 semantic `ui-record-open-overlay-modes-retired` (names the conversion in `conversionIds`), plus its STEP18_RATIONALE fragment.
  - The default change is declared in `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR` (`ui/NavigationConfig:mode "page" → "drawer"`); `authorable-defaults/ui.json` regenerated.
  - No `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` row and no liveness row: no key changed. As the skill predicts for an enum-value narrowing, `authorable-surface/`, `api-surface/` and `json-schema.manifest/` are byte-identical; `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts current.
  - Removal-version pin: a JOIN row for the conversion. Describes updated (the three component `navigation` describes say four values; the react-blocks `navigation` type), reference docs and `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` regenerated.
- Pin: `packages/spec/src/ui/navigation-mode-retirement.test.ts` (in the `repo` project; added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`): every carrier refuses each retired member with `invalid_value` at the member's path and the prescription's first sentence; `defineStack` refuses with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422; live members and the `drawer` default; a misspelt member keeps zod's own message; a `@ts-expect-error` at the authoring site; the conversion over stored view / page / object rows, idempotence, retired from the load path, wiring and the D3 entry; the page form's three options; a tree-scoped absence walk over the radius `@objectstack/spec#test` already declares.

### Console (`ui/`)

- `useNavigationOverlay`: a block without `mode` falls back to `drawer` (the spec default), and `isOverlay` is `mode === 'drawer'`. The absent-block branch is untouched: it stays the host's call (the hook's docblock explains why a host withholds navigation that way).
- `NavigationOverlay`: the `modal` and `popover` faces are deleted, with `popoverTrigger`, `popoverAnchorRef` and the `useOverlayAnchor` export — measured unreachable (below). The drawer face and the `split` face stay; `NavigationOverlayMode` is `page | drawer | split | new_window | none`.
- Grid, calendar, kanban, gantt and tree drop their `split` branches and popover anchor plumbing; their `navIsOverlay` reads `drawer` only.
- The field-count guess is retired from the list → record path: `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` resolves an un-authored list to the drawer whatever the field count (the drawer's width still follows the count), and plugin-view's `ObjectView` uses `layout || (mobile ? page : drawer)`. Mobile still pages there; the app-shell path never passed a viewport to the guess, so its comment claiming "mobile always pages" was corrected rather than given a new behaviour. The record FORM's surface (`recordFormNavigation.ts`, `AppContent.tsx`) is untouched, as ruled.
- The split pane is a reader preference: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts` (`drawer | split`, default `drawer`, `localStorage` key `os:record-open-mode`, default on SSR, a throwing storage or an unknown value). The console's `ObjectView` draws the split face when the preference is `split` AND the resolved mode is `drawer`; a declared `page` keeps its declaration. The split face reuses the drawer's URL state (`?recordId=`). The Display-menu control that writes the key is #26681.
- `appObjectScope.ts`: `IN_PAGE_RECORD_OVERLAYS` and its route check are removed (below).
- `InterfaceListPage` narrows `recordAction` to the three live values. The Studio list-view inspector's mode-label map is keyed by the spec's `NavigationMode`, and the three retired labels leave its i18n table.
- Registry `navigation` input descriptions (eight plugins) and `sdui.manifest.json` regenerated (`gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`; the diff is those eight descriptions only). Docs: `plugin-view` page and README stop teaching the field-count guess; the calendar, kanban, gantt, map, timeline, tree, grid and detail docs stop teaching the retired modes; `ui/packages/types` describes and docblocks citing `default('page')` updated.
- `e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`: the centred-dialog case mounted `NavigationOverlay`'s modal face, which is gone; it now mounts the Shadcn `Dialog` primitive, so the objectui#13340 top-centre path under a centred Radix dialog keeps its coverage.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **`ViewNavigationConfig` is the spec alias, so the narrowing reds `Type Check UI` by itself** — held. The first type-check after the spec build read `object-kanban-calendar-navigation-8652.test.ts(233,17): error TS2322: Type '"modal"' is not assignable to type '"none" | "page" | "drawer" | "new_window" | undefined'` (and the same in timeline, kanban, calendar and plugin-view tests). That red is also this PR's reverse verification that tsc read the rebuilt declarations.
2. **The hook mentions the three values only at its fallback and `isOverlay`** — held; the pins that rested on the `page` fallback were flipped (list below).
3. **`NavigationOverlay` mounts** — there are 19 mounts on this tree, not nine. All but three spread the hook's state (mode from metadata); `RecordDetailDrawer` passes `drawer`; plugin-view's two passed `split` / `popover` derived from `navigationConfig.mode`. With the values gone from metadata no caller reaches `modal` or `popover`, so those faces were deleted; `split` is reached by a non-metadata caller (the preference) and stays.
4. **`IN_PAGE_RECORD_OVERLAYS`** — its one consumer widened the object scope for a list whose views open records in an overlay the URL does not carry. No such mode remains, and the split preference rides `?recordId=`, which `hasRecordOverlay` already covers, so the set and its check were removed.
5. **The two guess sites and the two doc pages** — held as listed.
6. **HotCRM and in-repo authorings** — HotCRM `1f3f8880` declares `page` (lead) and `drawer` (opportunity, task, case) only. In this repo no source outside `ui/` authors a retired member (control: 39 `drawer` / `page` authorings found by the same expression), and the tree-scoped pin holds that.

## Tests (final head `eb20d22070` unless stated)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 730 files passed, 1 failed (`scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts`, a child process's JSON truncated near 64 KB: macOS pipes are asynchronous, a known local-only failure, green in CI). `test:repo`: 79 passed, 1 failed (`build-schemas-check-mode.manifest.test.ts` generation stamp, the other known local-only failure).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (it includes `check:test-typecheck`, so the new `@ts-expect-error` is compiled).
- UI type-check, 14 packages via turbo (`types`, `react`, `components`, the eight plugins, `plugin-view`, `plugin-detail`, `app-shell`): 77 tasks successful.
- UI vitest: `packages/app-shell/` 1759 files / 16173 tests passed (pre-merge); the twelve other touched packages 1799 files passed with 10 failures, all fixed and re-run green except three `git grep -E` word-boundary LIT CONTROLs (BSD regex has no `\b`; local-only). Post-merge re-run of every changed test file plus `plugin-grid/` and `types` tests: 674 passed, the same three local-only failures.
- Ablations (each committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): `enumWithRetiredValues` → `z.enum` reds 12 prescription rows of the spec pin; `default('drawer')` → `default('page')` reds 2 rows; the hook's `?? 'drawer'` → `?? 'page'` reds 4 rows across the two hook pins. Direction expected and observed: red.
- `e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`: NOT MEASURED locally — the cached Playwright browsers are build 1234 and the runner asks for 1243; nothing was installed. `Build & E2E UI` runs it.

### Pins flipped, not deleted

Hook default (`useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault`, `hostRecordNavigator-11293`, `offline-nav-performance-spec-parity`); the per-renderer mode-less rows (kanban, calendar, timeline, map, tree, grid `gridNavigationMembers-8071`, gantt `objectGanttInputs-11168`, `navigationModeResolution-7334`, `navigationPageSink-7334`, `objectTimelineInputs-11168`); the five `overlayShellModes-9299` files (a retired mode reaching a renderer past the parse now opens no shell, against a drawer lit control); `ObjectView.pageSurfaceFallback-11015` (the field-heavy object with an `onNavigate` used to route to a page — it now opens the drawer and never routes); `ObjectView.splitPopoverCreate-10975` (a stale `split` opens on the fallback surface, never beside the list); the types parity pins (four members, the three retired asserted absent); the spec-default controls in `object-grid-properties-bag-11276` and `object-gantt-properties-bag-10859-b6`; `dialogViewportGutterCensus-12603` (the record modal dialog is gone, not converged). The app-shell split tests (`recordCountFooter-10636`, `viewRefusal-12112`) now open the pane through the preference, and `ObjectView.recordOpenPreference-26677.test.tsx` pins the three cases (preference `split` → the pane; no preference → the drawer; a view declaring `page` → neither).

### Tests deleted

`ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.overlayTitleI18n.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.overlayTitleNoProviderFallback.test.tsx` pinned the heading of plugin-view's split panel, a face this PR removes; the subject no longer exists. Its absence is pinned by the FLIPPED rows of `ObjectView.splitPopoverCreate-10975.test.tsx` (no `Tasks Detail` heading, no `Close panel` control).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this branch derives 125 families; all were run with exit codes recorded and reconciled with `--ran`: 124 run, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET — it needs a full build). Two exit 1s are local-environment readings: `pnpm check:bash32-floor` (its self-test probes bash 4 syntax; this host's bash is 3.2.57), and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (two tests hit their 15 s timeout under load and pass on a re-run with a longer timeout; two need `mapfile`, absent from bash 3.2). `pnpm check:i18n` and the spec `check:skill-examples` first refused their prerequisite and passed after building their closures; `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` first named the new tree-walking pin, which now sits in the spec `repo` project. Also run: `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `type-check:coverage`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:phantom-deps` — all exit 0; ui eslint over the changed files: 0 errors. Final-head union re-run: reported in the issue comment.

## Declared narrowing — verification ran UNLOCKED

`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` could not take the shared verify lock on this host: no usable `flock`. The shared verify lock is declared Linux-only (`flock` is util-linux, and a stock macOS does not ship it), so every heavy command in this PR (spec build, spec tests, ui type-check and vitest runs, the SDUI manifest regeneration, the ablations) ran directly, without the lock — a declared narrowing, not a silent one. No serialization guarantee held for these runs, nor for any sibling agent in this container while they ran. A second dispatched agent (#26678) shared the container.

The downstream sweep `pnpm --filter '...@objectstack/spec' typecheck` was not run; in its place, a source census found no package outside `ui/` that names a retired member, and `TypeScript Type Check` runs every package.

## Acceptance notes

- The hook's absent-block branch still hands a click to the host's `onNavigate` (a page). It is documented as the way a host withholds navigation (the related list's mobile gallery), so it is not changed here; the spec default reaches every block that is present. No card.
- The prescriptions say a side-by-side pane is "a reader's own preference in the list's Display menu, not metadata", as the card prescribes. The Display-menu control that writes the preference is #26681; if 18.3.0 publishes before it lands, the sentence names a control that is not there yet. Carrier: #26681.
- This PR changes 4054 lines and touches `skills/**`, so it lands the Tier H way (an authorized approval, then the owning seat).
- Local-only failures recorded above (three `git grep -E` word-boundary controls in `ui/packages/types`, the macOS pipe truncation in `check-liveness.test.ts`, the generation-stamp test, bash 3.2 probes) reproduce on any macOS checkout and are green in CI. Carrier: none.

## `skills/**` readings

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`: 162 → 162 lines (the Surface bullet rewritten in place: the drawer, `page` only where declared, no `modal` mode).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` (generated): 115 → 115.
- All `SKILL.md`: 4606 → 4606. The `objectstack-ui` package, every file: 2259 → 2259. No re-wrap, no growth.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 列表点开一条记录的方式收成一种默认:抽屉(可展开成整页);只有声明了 `page` 的对象才直接打开整页。元数据里的 `navigation.mode` 不再接受 `modal`、`split`、`popover`,列表页的 `recordAction` 不再接受 `modal`,写了会在校验时被拒并给出改法;省略 `mode` 时默认值从 `page` 改成 `drawer`。控制台不再按字段多少替用户猜"整页还是抽屉"。左右分栏改成每个用户自己的浏览器偏好(本卡只做读取,设置开关在 #26681)。
- **为什么改:** 维护者裁决:一个对象一个默认打开方式,抽屉和整页是同一张页的两种宽度;弹窗和浮层是同一条记录的多余入口,分栏是读者自己的选择,不该由作者替所有人决定。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** ① 写了这三个值的源码会在 18.3 校验失败,需要删掉该值(`os migrate meta --from 17` 列出改法,`--write` 可直接改);数据库里已保存的视图会在读取时自动转换为抽屉,不会报错。② 以前因字段多而自动整页打开的对象,现在默认用抽屉打开;需要整页的对象要显式声明 `page`。③ 由旧工具链解析过、已把 `page` 写死的产物仍按整页打开,删掉该值即可改用抽屉。④ 组件包删除了 `useOverlayAnchor` 导出和弹窗、浮层两种外壳,外部若直接用了会编译失败。回滚即 revert 本 PR,不写数据,没有不可逆动作。
